## Summary

- Text pairs (4.5:1): 42 pass, 0 fail
- Non-text pairs (3:1): 10 pass, 0 fail
- Highlighter and rule rows are informational (background-only / decorative) and not counted.

## Failures

None.

Rules applied: red pen (`--red-pen` / `--chalk-pen`) must pass 4.5:1 wherever it is used for small text (corrections, hand notes, error text); highlighter (`--highlight`) is background-only, so only the ink on it is checked.
